description: Central campaigner for the abolition of the so-called marriage penalty and against the switch to individual taxation; views marriage as an economic community and backs The Centre's Fairness Initiative for fair federal taxation of married couples.
Lawyer and notary by profession; member of the National Council Committee for Legal Affairs (RK-N).
Member of the Committee for Economic Affairs and Taxation (WAK-N); ties to the Swiss and Valais trade associations and homeowners' association reflect an SME, business and property-owner focus.

Declared connections to energy-supply companies (enalpin, naturenergie) and to transport-infrastructure committees (Loetschberg axis, Grimsel tunnel), reflecting an interest in Alpine energy and transport policy.

area: Viticulture, tourism and regional Valais economy
description: Connections to the Swiss wine industry association, mountain railways and resort foundations reflect engagement for the Valais wine, tourism and mountain economy.
